name: AlphaInfo Signal Monitor for Security Operations

info.description: Defensive monitoring for security-operations telemetry — event volumes, authentication failure rates, network and OT metrics. Classifies signal structure as stable / transition / unstable and marks regime transitions as operational deviations, so teams triage structural change instead of threshold noise. Verdict badge, overlay, optional per-window deep timeline, live quota footer.
